entries.partTitle: Reliability Pillar: High Availability Engineering, MTTR Reduction & Fault Domains

left.title: Single Zone System
items: Single datacenter failure triggers full outage.
Manual recovery requires hours of downtime.
Lacks chaos engineering verification drills.

right.title: Well-Architected Multi-AZ
items: Multi-AZ deployment eliminates single points of failure.
Automated self-healing achieves four nines uptime.
Cell-based architecture isolates blast radius.

steps.annotation: Single datacenter deployments suffer catastrophic downtime during outages.
Multi-AZ architectures eliminate single failure points across layers.
Engine calculates uptime availability percentage and confirms four nines.
Automated self-healing and cell architecture ensure continuous reliability.

entries.partTitle: Security Pillar: Zero-Trust Identity, KMS Envelope Encryption & Network Isolation

left.title: Perimeter Security
items: Relies on vulnerable network perimeter firewalls.
Hardcoded credentials risk git repository leaks.
Direct KMS calls hit account rate limits.

right.title: Zero-Trust & Envelope
items: IAM least privilege and temporary STS tokens.
KMS envelope encryption protects petabytes of data.
GuardDuty machine learning detects threat activity.

steps.annotation: Perimeter only security fails when internal network credentials leak.
Zero-trust architecture enforces least privilege identity across all APIs.
Security engine generates master envelope keys with secure data lengths.
Envelope encryption secures petabyte scale data without rate throttling.

entries.partTitle: Cost Optimization: AWS Graviton Migration, S3 Intelligent-Tiering & FinOps Allocation

left.title: Unmonitored Compute
items: Over-provisioned x86 instances run idle.
Unused data remains permanently in standard S3.
Lacks cost allocation tagging and anomaly alerts.

right.title: Graviton & Intelligent S3
items: Graviton delivers twenty percent compute cost savings.
S3 Intelligent-Tiering automatically cuts storage bills.
Savings Plans and Spot instances maximize efficiency.

steps.annotation: Unmonitored cloud spending rapidly erodes corporate profit margins.
Graviton processors deliver superior compute performance at lower costs.
Engine calculates monthly savings achieved through Graviton migration.
FinOps cost allocation tags provide financial transparency across domains.

entries.partTitle: Multi-Region Resilience: Active-Active Routing, Route 53 Health Checks & RTO/RPO

left.title: Single Region Cloud
items: Vulnerable to undersea cable cuts and power loss.
High international user latency across oceans.
Cold standby DR requires hours of manual recovery.

right.title: Active-Active Multi-Region
items: Simultaneously serves traffic across multiple regions.
Route 53 health checks auto-failover in seconds.
Asynchronous data replication achieves sub-second lag.

steps.annotation: Single region architectures cannot survive catastrophic regional outages.
Active-active multi-region deployments serve live global user traffic.
Router directs traffic to primary region and auto fails over if degraded.
Asynchronous replication achieves sub second recovery points globally.

entries.partTitle: Well-Architected Synthesis: Enterprise Review, Audit Scoring & Verification Token

left.title: Unreviewed Architecture
items: Accumulates high risk issues and technical debt.
Lacks multi-pillar compliance verification.
No formal audit readiness confirmation token.

right.title: Well-Architected Score
items: One hundred percent score in reliability and security.
Verified multi-region active-active capability.
Emits cryptographic confirmation token upon test.

steps.annotation: Unreviewed cloud systems carry hidden architectural and security risks.
Well-Architected reviews systematically evaluate workloads against pillars.
Auditor evaluates platform metrics across reliability security and cost.
Synthesis confirms enterprise readiness and emits verified capstone token.
